svg.title: One iteration of nested cross-validation pipeline
svg.desc: Flowchart showing data flow through one iteration of 5-fold outer / 3-fold inner nested cross-validation, highlighting where preprocessing is applied and how data leakage is prevented.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about the dataset used in the nCV pipeline')

svg.text: Outer loop — 5-fold stratified CV (one fold shown)

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Why do we use stratified splitting in nested CV?')
sendPrompt('What happens to the outer training set in nested CV?')
sendPrompt('Why is the outer test set locked away during training?')

svg.text: Inner loop — 3-fold stratified CV (one fold shown)

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the inner split work for hyperparameter tuning?')
sendPrompt('What preprocessing steps are fitted on the inner train set?')
sendPrompt('How is the inner validation set used?')
sendPrompt('How does Optuna handle hyperparameter search in the inner loop?')
g.text: Optuna — 50 trials · best HPs by MCC / AUC

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Why do we refit on the full outer training set after hyperparameter search?')
sendPrompt('Which metrics are computed on the outer test fold?')

svg.text: Repeat for all 5 outer folds → 5 metric scores per repetition

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do we aggregate results across 10 repetitions of nested CV?')
